NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and fires a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Your backend processes the order and delivers the product automatically. No platform involved at any step.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the backbone enabling digital creators to operate independently from traditional payment platforms. In regions like Nigeria, where Stripe operates in only 46 out of 195 countries, many creators are effectively locked out of the global economy. This infrastructure allows you to bypass these restrictions entirely, giving you the ability to sell ebooks and other digital products without the limitations imposed by conventional payment processors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce is built on a combination of free and affordable tools that work seamlessly together. For instance, you can host your ecommerce site on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. This stack allows for automatic crypto payment processing through NOWPayments, which eliminates the need for a traditional payment gateway, ensuring a smooth delivery of digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators operating in regions where PayPal, Stripe, and other payment processors are either restricted or unavailable. Whether you’re an ebook author in Nigeria, a course creator in Ghana, or a digital artist in Kenya, this infrastructure provides you with the tools necessary to monetize your work. By using a sovereign commerce stack, you regain control over your sales process and eliminate dependencies on unreliable platforms.
Own your digital store outright without platform dependencies.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each element of the sovereign commerce stack is a critical part of the whole. Hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages ensures your store is accessible. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the backend logic, while Supabase or Google Sheets handle order storage. NOWPayments facilitates payment processing in over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept payments globally without the need for traditional banking systems, providing a comprehensive solution for digital sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. After that, choose a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for your product orders. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to enable crypto transactions. For a more streamlined approach, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes all the necessary components pre-configured for your use.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Eliminate the risk of account suspensions affecting your earnings.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for alternatives to Gumroad or want to sell digital products without a Gumroad account, our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a complete solution. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore our offerings and learn how to take control of your digital sales.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

You can utilize sovereign commerce infrastructure, which allows you to set up an online store using free tools. By hosting on platforms like GitHub or Cloudflare and integrating NOWPayments, you can sell ebooks and other digital products directly.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?

The best alternative is to implement a sovereign commerce stack that includes hosting, backend logic, and payment processing without relying on traditional platforms. This architecture ensures you can sell digital products freely without restrictions.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Using PayPal in these countries is often challenging due to account restrictions and operational limitations. Instead, consider adopting a decentralized payment solution like NOWPayments to manage transactions without a traditional payment gateway.
What happens if PayPal suspends my account?

A PayPal account suspension can lock your funds for up to 180 days without recourse or appeal, leaving you without access to your earnings. This risk emphasizes the need for a more reliable payment processing infrastructure.
How can I start accepting cryptocurrency payments?

You can start by integrating NOWPayments into your ecommerce setup. This allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, providing a flexible and efficient payment option for your customers.
Leverage cryptocurrency to unlock global payment possibilities.
